verdict.rationale: Godot runs an official Asset Library with categories for 2D/3D tools, shaders, materials, scripts, templates and demos, plus a keyless JSON API for querying assets. Its documented editor-plugin and import-plugin system supports the plugins and tools part of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows the library is large, and ready-made models are not clearly offered as a category. missing for 10: evidence of ecosystem scale/size, explicit ready-made 3D model/art asset offerings, independent or hands-on corroboration of the library's breadth and quality.
